why: Doc quote is VERBATIM (skills.md line 920, first sentence of a four-sentence line; the rest adds skillOverrides "name-only" and skillListingMaxDescChars, and does not reverse the claim). The cited evidence line is also correct: packages/shared/src/skills/storage.ts:81 is `const MAX_DERIVED_DESCRIPTION_CHARS = 1_536;`, applied only to a description DERIVED from the body. And `grep -ran` (NUL-safe) over all .ts/.tsx/.js/.json outside node_modules/dist returns ZERO hits for skillListingBudgetFraction, SLASH_COMMAND_TOOL_CHAR_BUDGET and skillListingMaxDescChars, so the identifier half of the claim is true. The finding is refuted on step 3: the stated OUR STATE names the WRONG SUBSYSTEM and therefore reports a false consequence. `packages/shared/src/agent/pi-harness/capability-catalog.ts:108` (not :107 -- line 107 is `kind: input.kind,`) is NOT the skill listing path. It is the Pi-harness capability/tool catalog whose kinds are `'builtin' | 'session' | 'plugin' | 'mcp' | 'app'` (capability-catalog.ts:9) -- there is no skill kind -- and whose own comment at :84-88 says the clamped text is "Free text shown to the model in `mcp__tool_search` results." That is the sibling-subsystem trap named in AGENTS.md and in inert-worklist section 4 shape 4. The REAL skill listing is `PromptBuilder.buildSkillListingPart()` (packages/shared/src/agent/core/prompt-builder.ts:403-447), and it does have a listing character budget and a per-entry description cap: `SKILL_LISTING_MAX_CHARS = 4_000` (:105) enforced at :433 with a truthful "(N more skills not listed)" overflow at :441-444, and `SKILL_LISTING_DESCRIPTION_MAX_CHARS = 180` (:113) applied per entry by `boundedListingText` (:126-131). So "no listing budget" and "512 chars per entry" are both wrong; the true numbers are 4,000 total and 180 per entry. The deviation is also RECORDED WITH A REASON, not undiscovered: prompt-builder.ts:107-113 cites Claude's figure explicitly -- "Claude truncates a skill's `description` (plus `when_to_use`) at 1,536 characters in its own listing, but that is a per-entry cap against a much larger listing budget; here one verbose skill must not be able to consume the whole block, so an entry gets one line" -- and docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-26-skills-invocation.md states it as a Global Constraint (:64-67: the listing "must be bounded by a stated budget, and the budget must be a constant with a comment saying what it costs, not a magic number"), with a measured cost table at :580-590. The driver is architectural and fork-specific: the listing rides Pi's CACHED system prefix and is paid on every request of every session (prompt-builder.ts:99-104), which is also why a fixed constant was chosen over a context-window fraction. It is NOT one of the nine dated owner decisions in inert-worklist section 3 (those are SEATBELT_TESTING_WILDCARD, availableModels/enforceAvailableModels, autoMode.classifyAllShell, ManagedDeliveryStateV1.drops, plugins/hooks-runtime.ts, SdkMcpServerConfig.required, SessionMirrorStore.delete, MirrorSessionKey.subpath/listSubkeys, listSessionSummaries/listSessions) -- it is a plan-recorded design decision instead.
correctedState: Nessy DOES implement a bounded skill listing, in `PromptBuilder.buildSkillListingPart()` (packages/shared/src/agent/core/prompt-builder.ts:403-447): a whole-listing budget of `SKILL_LISTING_MAX_CHARS = 4_000` characters (:105, enforced :433, with a truthful "(N more skills not listed)" overflow line :441-444) and a per-entry description cap of `SKILL_LISTING_DESCRIPTION_MAX_CHARS = 180` (:113, applied by `boundedListingText` :126-131). `capability-catalog.ts:108`'s 512-char `clampedText(input.description, ...)` belongs to a DIFFERENT subsystem -- the Pi capability/tool catalog behind `mcp__tool_search`, whose kinds are builtin/session/plugin/mcp/app and include no skills -- and is not the skill listing path. The genuine residual difference is narrower than claimed and is a recorded design decision, not an oversight: (a) the budget is a fixed 4,000-character constant rather than 1% of the model's context window, chosen deliberately because the listing sits inside Pi's cached system prefix and is paid on every request (prompt-builder.ts:99-104; plan 2026-07-26-skills-invocation.md:64-67 requires "a constant with a comment saying what it costs"); (b) it is not user-tunable -- `skillListingBudgetFraction`, `SLASH_COMMAND_TOOL_CHAR_BUDGET` and `skillListingMaxDescChars` have no reader anywhere in the repo (verified with NUL-safe `grep -ran`); (c) our per-entry cap is 180 characters, tighter than Claude's 1,536, and prompt-builder.ts:107-113 states the reason (one verbose skill must not consume the whole block); (d) overflow drops WHOLE ENTRIES in key order and reports the count, where Claude drops DESCRIPTIONS by least-invoked priority and keeps every name. `MAX_DERIVED_DESCRIPTION_CHARS = 1_536` (skills/storage.ts:81) correctly mirrors Claude's number for its own separate purpose: bounding a description derived from the SKILL.md body.
